d:
Purv sansad aanand mohan ko suprim kort se jhatka laga hai. shirsh adalat ne unki rihaee ko nirast karte hue ek mahine ke andar sarendar karne ka aadesh diya hai. is phaisle ke bad bihar ki siyasi sargarmi barh gaee hai. aarjedi ke karyakari adhyaksh tejasvi yadav ne kaha ki bijepi aur nitish kumar apne phayde ke hisab se logon ka istemal karte hain. pahle anant sinh aur phir aanand mohan ko yuj kar phenk diya gaya.
